Pocket Sense tracks your money offline first, keeps each account's data private, and includes an AI assistant that runs on your phone.

> **Upgrading from an earlier build?** This is the first release signed with the permanent release key, so Android can't install it over a previous build. Open the old app and check the cloud icon shows ✓ (everything synced), then uninstall it and install this APK. Sign in and your data downloads again. Later releases will install as normal updates.

## Download
- **`PocketSense-v1.2.1-arm64-v8a.apk`**: almost all modern Android phones. Use this one if unsure.
- `PocketSense-v1.2.1-armeabi-v7a.apk`: older 32-bit phones
- `PocketSense-v1.2.1-x86_64.apk`: emulators and Chromebooks

Requires Android 7.0 or later.

## Features

### 🏠 Home
- This month's income, spending and net, plus year-to-date spending.
- Daily spending chart for the last 30 days, with a readable axis, and a by-category breakdown.
- Recent activity showing the actual time each entry was recorded.

### 💸 Activity
- Add, edit and delete income and expenses, with merchant, category and notes.
- Search by description or merchant, and filter by All, Expense or Income.

### 🎯 Budgets
- A spending limit per category, with progress, what's remaining, and over-budget warnings.

### 🔁 Recurring
- Recurring **expenses and income** (bills, subscriptions, salary), charged weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly.
- Pick the **first due date** with a date picker. See what's due or overdue at a glance.
- **Post as transaction** in one tap. Pause an item without deleting it.

### 🤖 Ask: on-device assistant
- Ask *"How much did I spend this month?"* or *"Log $8.50 coffee at Blue Bottle"*.
- Runs Qwen2.5-1.5B (about 0.9 GB, downloaded once on your first question) **fully offline**. Your data never leaves the phone.
- Answers from your real data. It can add transactions but never edit or delete.

### 🔐 Accounts
- Register, sign in, and reset your password with an emailed code.
- Each account only ever sees its own data, enforced by the database.
- You stay signed in between launches, including offline.

### ☁️ Offline-first sync
- Everything saves on the device immediately and uploads to the cloud within about a second, or once you're back online.
- The **cloud icon** in the app bar shows whether everything is synced, changes are waiting to upload, you're offline, or there's a problem. Tap it to **Sync now**.
- Deletes and edits sync reliably, and changes made on another device, including deletions, show up here.
- Pull to refresh on any tab.

### ⚙️ Settings
- Manage your categories, see which account you're signed in with, and log out. Open it from the gear icon.

## Fixed in this release
- Deleted and edited records didn't reach the cloud. The upload queue failed silently, and local IDs didn't match the server's.
- Home showed **00:00** as the time of every recent transaction.
- The daily spending chart drew hundreds of overlapping labels on its left axis, and its line dipped below $0.

## Known limitations
- One currency (US dollars).
- Weekly budgets are measured against the calendar month for now.
- Activity has no date picker yet, so new transactions are dated today.
- The assistant adds transactions without asking you to confirm.
